job_description: **Introduction** A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. **Your role and responsibilities** As an Application Developer specializing in Asset Management, you will design, develop, and support Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) applications using IBM Maximo and related technologies. This role focuses on creating efficient, reliable, and maintainable EAM solutions that meet the organization's needs. Your primary responsibilities will include: - Develop Application Components: Design, create, and modify application components to support EAM applications, ensuring compatibility across various platforms. - Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages with IBM Maximo and related technologies to deliver comprehensive EAM solutions. - Develop Reports and Interfaces: Develop, test, and maintain reports, interfaces, data conversions, and enhancements using IBM Maximo and related tools. - Ensure Compatibility: Ensure compatibility of EAM applications across various platforms, leveraging IBM Maximo and related technologies. - Maintain Solutions: Maintain and support existing EAM solutions to ensure they remain efficient, reliable, and meet the organization's evolving needs. Must be eligible for a Secret Clearance **Required technical and professional expertise** - Exposure to IBM Maximo: Experience working with IBM Maximo and related technologies to design, develop, and support Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) applications. - Application Development Skills: Exposure to developing application components, integrating software packages, and ensuring compatibility across various platforms. - Report Development: Experience working with report development, testing, and maintenance using IBM Maximo and related tools. - EAM Solution Development: Exposure to creating efficient, reliable, and maintainable EAM solutions that meet organizational needs. - Technical Integration: Experience working with integrating software packages with IBM Maximo and related technologies to deliver comprehensive EAM solutions. Must be eligible for a Secret Clearance **Preferred technical and professional experience** - Familiarity with EAM Technologies: Exposure to Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) technologies and related tools, in addition to IBM Maximo, is beneficial for this role. - Knowledge of Software Integration: Experience with integrating software packages beyond IBM Maximo is advantageous in delivering comprehensive EAM solutions. - Understanding of Report Development Tools: Familiarity with report development tools related to IBM Maximo can enhance report development, testing, and maintenance capabilities. IBM is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, caste, genetics, pregnancy, disability, neurodivergence, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. IBM is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
